COLDGATE, $COLDGATE, is a token on Robinhood Chain launched through Pons, attached to a free, read-only watch on eight exchanges: Binance, Coinbase, OKX, Bybit, Kraken, Bitget, KuCoin and Gate.

Every asset and network an exchange publishes becomes two lamps, one for deposits and one for withdrawals. A lamp frosts only when the exchange itself flags that route as paused, and a paused route is never read as a closed exchange. An exchange that publishes no usable feed reads NO FEED and gets no colour.

Every proof of reserves figure keeps the date the exchange published it, its source page and a hash of that page. Paste an EVM deposit address and COLDGATE checks it against the public Dune Spellbook list of exchange wallets, answering match, other exchange, conflicting labels or no match.

Reserve and price data is built with Chainlink feeds, read live on the board. Alerts through Push are built and switch on once the channel is live.

COLDGATE shows what an exchange publishes, not what happens inside it.

A 3% fee on every BUCKET trade buys real tokenized stocks and crypto and delivers them straight to holder wallets, automatically. No staking, no claiming, no wrapper.
